authority: Owner-approved reorganization on 2026-10-21; numbered families and lettered subgoals. Organization does not authorize new compute, publication or deployment.
scope: Current organization of algorithm recognition, reusable languages, human studies, autonomous composition and research quality. Historical IDs are namespaced by v1 contract and retain their original meaning.

1a.name: Qualified known-specification retrieval
1a.definition: Language-agnostic known-problem recognition/retrieval returns a value containing one or more separately qualified implementations in any language; the consuming program selects the implementation. Language is not part of recognizer identity.

1b.name: One informal answer or abstention
1b.definition: One informal natural-language description to language-agnostic matched solution value or abstention, with zero clarification questions. The value may contain multiple separately qualified language implementations; the consumer chooses.

1c.name: Coverage and complete latency
1c.definition: Expand separately qualified eligible coverage and measure complete retrieval, public verification and serving latency, including failures, cold/warm behavior and abstentions. Similarity or a vector alone is not answer correctness.

2a.name: Versioned exact-string vocabularies
2a.definition: Compare separate 64/128/256-entry, 6/7/8-bit exact UTF-8 codebooks per language/profile, with compression-first and human-readable candidate policies. A profile uses stable global IDs and no per-problem remapping, free escape, implicit indentation, operand substitution or hidden source expansion. Preserve fixed-source reconstruction controls.

2b.name: Behavior-preserving joint composition
2b.definition: Jointly optimize vocabulary and successor programs, including alternative algorithms. Qualify full outputs, ordering, allowed mutation/alias, numeric/Unicode/exception behavior and required time/space complexity against the pinned problem contract, not incidental reference behavior. Exact decoding reconstructs the selected successor bytes, not necessarily original bytes. Independently review and test before variant admission; retain counterexamples and versioned repairs. Finite tests are evidence, not proof.

2c.name: Structured and parameterized languages
2c.definition: Study macros, typed AST constructors and editor actions as separate representations with charged bindings, operands, scopes, control/navigation and decoder semantics. Preserve v1 macro whole-solution policy separately from literal/M1 whole-solution exclusions; do not inherit literal bit costs for hidden expansion.

3.name: Human BITS fluency and independent solving

3a.name: Learn and retain stable mappings
3a.definition: Measure acquisition, retention and delayed recall under a versioned stable codebook and declared practice budget. Readability or a 64-slot cap does not establish memorability.

3b.name: Independent unfamiliar-problem solving
3b.definition: Evaluate people solving independently selected unfamiliar problems without guided sequences or answer revelation. Seal task requirements/answers and track prior exposure separately from autonomous reservations; guided replay does not qualify.

3c.name: Complete interaction comparison
3c.definition: Compare complete time to correct solution, inputs, errors, corrections, navigation and controls against ordinary coding under matched tasks, training and tooling. Include failures, uncertainty and participant-level outcomes; automated UI tests are mechanism evidence only.

4a.name: Autonomous known-problem assembly
4a.definition: Given the problem description, assemble a complete program without human steering or query-time autoregressive source generation. Score macro and literal tracks separately; whole stored-program/sequence lookup is a separate control. Report first attempts and later repairs separately.

4b.name: Frozen unseen variants and families
4b.definition: Freeze vocabulary and assembly procedure before scoring independently reserved unseen semantic variants/families. Preserve original protected populations and family/alias closure; exposed development is never fresh generalization. Report correctness, wrong acceptances, abstentions and complete cost/latency.

4c.name: Neural primitive stretch
4c.definition: Explore learned primitives or neural composition as a separately declared stretch representation under the same qualification, first-attempt, accounting and protected-evaluation gates. Charge model/decoder/operand costs. No relaxation of 4a/4b, presumed neural benefit or training authorization follows from this target.

5a.name: Defensible novel mechanism or finding
5a.definition: Apply existing M6 gates: precise contribution beyond prior work, strong matched baselines/ablations, correctness and uncertainty audit, reproducible permitted artifacts and independent critical review. Internal readiness does not guarantee acceptance or authorize submission.

5b.name: Literature-leading matched performance
5b.definition: Apply existing M5 targets and comparator/cost/compute rules. Distinguish input compression, storage, human effort and autonomous solving; do not transfer superiority or novelty between tasks or representations.

2a.track: macro library and autonomous macro assembly

3a.track: literal representation/joint optimization; autonomous literal assembly separately

milestone_mapping.preservation: M1–M6 IDs, numerical thresholds, status qualifiers, failure histories and protected gates are unchanged; milestone numbers are not current goal-family numbers. Historical goal references in that document use the v1 alias map.

representation_policies.compression-first: Arbitrary exact strings and qualified source alternatives, with input/storage tradeoffs measured separately.
representation_policies.human-readable: Recognizable complete lines, statements, balanced blocks and fully counted reusable general functions/classes. Restrictive whole-function exclusions in a particular experiment are not the global family definition.
representation_policies.shared_boundary: No task-specific whole answer/wrapper/algorithm body may be represented as a generally reusable helper. Preserve each frozen representation policy, including distinct macro and M1 exclusions.

qualification_and_accounting: Qualify JavaScript/Python independently; original domains, interfaces and mutation/alias/numeric/Unicode/complexity obligations remain authoritative.
Freeze admitted problem, case, variant and candidate pools before matched 64/128/256-entry comparisons. Preserve all failures and unsupported cases in denominators.
Within each policy, match information and budgets across source-only, dictionary-only and joint arms; report candidate-policy/mining changes as factors.
Charge helpers, imports, operands, bindings, wrappers, whitespace, dictionary/decoder/model bytes, payload, padding, framing, controls, navigation and corrections as applicable.
Codebook/packet reconstruction, native correctness, human studies, autonomous results and deployment are separate evidence classes.

Existing mandatory 96-character configurations do not fit 64 entries. A separately reviewed explicit-basis/reachability-aware implementation is required; never count an unreachable sentinel as coverage.
No reclassification opens protected material, changes user-owned 1a/1b admission authority or changes authorization for training/publication/security.

implementation_boundary.present: Exact DP and joint selection among hash-pinned qualified variants in joint-v1; bounded capture-checked rewrites and helper alternatives in rewrite-v1. These are evidence-backed finite methods, not general program equivalence.
implementation_boundary.unestablished: Broad automatic alternative-algorithm generation/qualification, arbitrary-corpus compactness, human fluency, autonomous generalization and neural-primitive benefits remain unestablished.

ownership.admission: Existing coordinator/human-authorized ledger policy unchanged; this taxonomy grants no admission.

migration_rule: Never rewrite a frozen result or test gate to its new label. New prose names the v2 goal and, when needed, the legacy track/contract. An alias reorganizes evidence without promoting it.
